rationale: The agent successfully verified the user's identity, processed the exchange of the skateboards as requested, and initiated the return of the e-reader correctly. They provided confirmation before any changes were made and delivered accurate final information regarding the order statuses and refund processes. However, the return of the smartwatch was constrained by system policies, as it could only handle one return/exchange per order, but the agent communicated this clearly to the user. Overall, the agent adhered to the policy and successfully assisted the user.
